jobs.occupation: Municipal Data Mining & OParl Specialist (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Software Engineers; NLP Specialists; Data MinersStellenbeschreibung:Municipal Data Mining & OParl Specialist (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Software Engineers, NLP Specialists, Data Miners, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research initiative capturing and analyzing large volumes of public, unstructured text data from municipal information systems. By tracking local planning decisions before they hit official cadastral portals, we create early-warning systems for infrastructure development. In this role, you will build the automated agents that read and understand municipal government data. Your Focus & Responsibilities - API Integration: Develop and maintain Python-based interfaces to autonomously query municipal council information systems, primarily using the open OParl standard. - Document Parsing: Parse and structure extensive text documents, meeting minutes, and official zoning announcements (PDFs, HTML). - Text Mining & NLP: Apply regex, text mining, and fundamental NLP techniques to categorize administrative texts and extract spatial entities. - Data Harmonization: Clean and transfer the extracted, geocoded data into our central relational database architecture (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Solid practical experience in Python, data extraction, API handling, and unstructured format processing (PDF, OCR, JSON). Familiarity with OParl is a strong advantage. - Mindset: A proactive problem-solving attitude with an eye for extracting structured truth from bureaucratic texts.  - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); fluent or highly proficient German language skills are strictly required to accurately parse and interpret German administrative and legal texts. What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership.  How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-scraping@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Municipal Data Mining)

jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Software Engineers; Web Scrapers; OSINT SpecialistsStellenbeschreibung:Data Mining & OSINT Automation Specialist (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Software Engineers, Web Scrapers, OSINT Specialists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. Because not all valuable data exists as clean spatial polygons, we build systems that extract hidden knowledge from texts, complex web registries, and unstructured documents. In this role, you will build the autonomous agents that feed our intelligence engine.  Your Focus & Responsibilities - Web Automation: Develop scalable web scrapers and autonomous agents to extract data from unstructured sources (public registers, official announcements, corporate portals). - Data Parsing: Parse unstructured web and document data (JSON, XML, HTML, PDF) into clean, relational database structures. - Entity Extraction: Apply OCR, regex, and NLP techniques to extract structured entities (addresses, capacities, corporate connections) from dense documents. - Pipeline Monitoring: Automate monitoring scripts to continuously feed fresh data into our central PostGIS Data Lake. What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Proven experience in Web Scraping (Python, Playwright, Scrapy, Selenium, BeautifulSoup) and handling uncooperative web architectures. - Mindset: Analytical mindset with a drive for data cleaning, structural modeling, and robust automation. - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus. jobs.occupation: Geospatial Data Engineer & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Data Engineers; Software EngineersStellenbeschreibung:Geospatial Data Engineer & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, cadastre intelligence, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. Together with our commercial transfer network, we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application. Complex geospatial and resilience data models are deployed into active enterprise environments and infrastructure tools. In this role, you turn algorithmic frameworks and spatial datasets into robust, production-ready digital architectures.  Your Focus & Responsibilities - Geospatial Data Modeling: Develop and refine automated pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms.  - Spatial Inference: Implement spatial overlay models for energy grid matching and land analysis directly within our PostGIS cluster. - Data Harmonization: Validate, clean, and transform complex vector geometries into a single coordinate reference system (EPSG:25832) before database insertion. - Cloud Deployment: Package services into robust Docker environments and deploy them on secure server infrastructure.  What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Solid programming foundation in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS).  - Mindset: Strong analytical curiosity, proactive problem-solving attitude, and a clean-code engineering approach.  - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates currently in or moving to Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support for candidates combining practice with academics.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and German residence/work permit applications.  - Modern Work Environment: Work in a high-efficiency tech stack focused on high-value architecture rather than boilerplate tasks.
